sources:
Statewide layer: every RI city and town, three official numbers side by side.

  census    Census Building Permits Survey, units authorized, 2000-2025 (raw/bps/)
  doh_2024  RI Dept of Housing municipal permit survey + completions estimate, 2024
            (2024 Integrated Housing Report, Figures 2.1 and 2.3; raw/doh/2024.txt)
  doh_2025  RI Executive Office of Housing municipal survey, 2025: permits and certificates of
            occupancy (2025 Integrated Housing Report, Apr 15 2026, Figures 2.1, 2.3, 2.4; raw/doh/2025.txt)
  goal      Housing 2030 five-year permitting goal, 2026-2030 (housing.ri.gov/media/3401)

Writes data/statewide.json and data/census-permits-ri.csv.

2018.state_source: Housing Fact Book 2019, net of ADUs

2019.state_source: Housing Fact Book 2020, net of ADUs

2020.state_source: Housing Fact Book 2021, net of ADUs

2021.state_source: Housing Fact Book 2022, net of ADUs

2022.state_source: Housing Fact Book 2023, net of ADUs

2023.state_source: Housing Fact Book 2024, net of ADUs
